items.title: Rate limiting
items.body: - [ ] Ensure the registration form has rate limiting to prevent bots spamming the db

items.title: Rate limiting
items.body:
Any request for an uncached week makes about 36 requests to eAsistent. Simultaneous requests for the same week aren't merged, and nothing limits requests per client. That's a ban risk, which the startup backoff was meant to avoid.
